entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I placed last month. I'd like to start a return for some cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number please?
Thank you. I have the order right here. Before we proceed, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit issue. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but no matter what I do, they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. They just don't work for my feet.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Okay, I've checked your purchase date. It looks like you received them 29 days ago. According to our policy, you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.

That's great news, I appreciate that. Since I did have to go through the trouble of trying them out and now have to ship them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? I still need a good pair of shoes.

I'm glad I could get that return approved for you. I do understand your position, but I'm afraid my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for returns related to product fit. However, I will ensure you receive a pre-paid shipping label via email so there's no cost to you to send the shoes back.
Alright, a pre-paid label is fair. I was hoping for a bit more, but I'm happy to get the refund sorted out. Let's proceed with that.

Perfect. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive that shipping label and instructions in your email within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
